ratios.quote: We were in compliance with all covenants under the Credit Agreement as of September 30, 2026 (the net leverage ratio was 0.49 to 1.00, compared to a maximum net leverage ratio of 3.25 to 1.00 on a quarterly basis covering the trailing four consecutive fiscal quarters for each fiscal quarter).

parsed.notes: The maximum net leverage ratio of 3.25x is measured over the trailing four fiscal quarters. It may step up to 3.75x for a period of time after a material acquisition. The commitment fee and interest margin depend on credit rating and sustainability KPIs, not leverage, so they are not included. Senior Notes indenture covenants are excluded.
